title_as_printed: Alzheimer’s Disease Biomarker Decision-Making among Patients with Mild Cognitive Impairment and Their Care Partners

Task_Type.reason: Descriptive attitudes study: structured interviews with Likert ratings analysed by GEE, with no discrimination task.

Category.reason: Survey/interview data from a clinical sample.

Sample_N_Approx.quote: We completed interviews with 65 patients with MCI and 57 study partners.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Patients referred from University of California, Irvine health system clinicians.
